aboutEduID.info.string: What it is and may be used for

aboutEduID.paragraph.string: Depending on where you work or study you might only use your eduID account a few times, or you might use it every day. Some schools, institutions and services use eduID as their identity provider, this means you will use your eduID to gain access to their IT-systems. Or you may mainly use your eduID account to create and access other accounts, such as your student account or e.g. {link}.

aboutEduID.paragraph1.string: eduID is a federated identity - a user identity that can be used in several different organisations that have agreed on how identities will be managed. The basic idea is that a given user, who is authenticated with an organisation, is automatically authenticated with other organisations in the federation.

aboutEduID.paragraph2.string: Federated identities are one of the cornerstones of trust between organisations. Trust is based on all the organisations relying on all the others to carry out their authentication - identification and verification - properly and in a controlled and reliable IT environment.

aboutEduID.when.string: Log in at eduid.se when you:

aboutEduID.when1.string: apply to and accept your place at a university,

aboutEduID.when2.string: organise your student account for email and intranet,

aboutEduID.when4.string: lose a student account password and need to regain access,

aboutEduID.when5.string: administrate students taking the Digital national exam,

aboutEduID.when6.string: electronically sign documents with eduSign, read more at {edusignLink}.

aboutEduID.whyParagraph1.string: From the user's perspective, in the long-term eduID means fewer accounts to keep track of. For many organisations, identity management is a complex issue and it is necessary to work with confirmed users.

aboutEduID.whyParagraph2.string: There are many services that require identification of users. This is often done by the user entering an email address to which the service provider sends a password. Such a user is normally called unconfirmed, because the service provider does not really know who the user with that email address is - and for many services this is at a sufficient level. Through the use of eduID, identification of users is elevated to that of confirmed users. You can read more about these requirements in the Assurance levels help section.

aboutSunet.paragraph1.string: eduID is a service provided by SUNET - the Swedish University Computer Network, which is governed by the Swedish Research Council (Vetenskapsrådet). SUNET delivers data communication networks and many other related services to public organisations and higher education and research institutions.

aboutSunet.paragraph2.string: SUNET developed eduID to provide a secure common routine for managing identity in the higher education community, with adequate authorization levels of confirmed accounts. More information about SUNET is available at {sunet} (in Swedish).

Read more about the possible actions of each page below.

manageEduIDSettings.security1.string: Buttons to add multi-factor authentication to increase the security of your eduID by adding a layer called a security key to your login process besides password. By also verifying the security key it is bound to your identity, increasing the assurance level of your account. You can add as many as you wish and depending on your device (computer, mobile, operating system etc.), the options to add a security key include:

privacy.changeHeading.string: How can I change the appearance of eduID?

privacy.changeParagraph.string: The color mode of eduID.se is available in light or dark mode to adapt to user preference and will display according to your system settings. This can be overridden at any time by using the "Appearance" toggle control in the page footer. If no preference is set it defaults to a light theme.

privacy.paragraph.string: Read the full {privacy} regarding use of eduID at the Sunet website, where you also find contact information to our Dataskyddsombud and Integritetsskyddsmyndigheten (in Swedish).

privacy.paragraph1.string: Read the full {accessibility} regarding the eduID site at Sunets website, where you also find instructions on how to report accessibility issues. The report addresses how eduID adheres to the Swedish law governing accessibility to digital public services as well as currently known issues of the site (in Swedish).

privacy.paragraph2.string: It is of outmost importance to us that as many as possible are able to use the service in a convenient and safe manner and is one of the many ways eduID is always striving to improve.

privacy.policy.string: Summary of how eduID treats your information according to the policy:

privacy.policy1.string: stores information that you have provided as well as updates from trusted registers,

privacy.policy2.string: transfers information according to the data minimisation principle - never more than required,

privacy.policy3.string: uses the information to identify the individual for services you have chosen to use,

privacy.policy4.string: protects and stores the information securely,

privacy.policy5.string: develops using open source code accessible at GitHub,

privacy.policy6.string: enables removal of eduID and connections directly in the service,

privacy.policy7.string: stores log files recording use for 6 months,

privacy.policy8.string: retains inactive accounts for a maximum of 2 years,

securityLevel.addHeading.string: How do I implement MFA with eduID?

securityLevel.addParagraph.string: It is recommended to add more than one key to make sure you always have supported access to your account.

securityLevel.addSecurity.developer_comment: how add security key - must be used
securityLevel.addSecurity.string: Note: if you have added a security key to your eduID it must be used to log in to eduID, unless you turn off this feature under "Manage your security keys" in the Security section. You might still need to use your security key if other connecting services require MFA.

securityLevel.addSecurityKey.string: When logged in you can add, verify and remove keys of your choice (provided you have access to any of these methods) in the Security area of eduID and follow the instructions. Under the "Add a new security key" label are the options:

securityLevel.choosing.string: Check with the manufacturer or retailer that the product meets the following requirements before it is acquired:

securityLevel.description.string: Some services will require a higher security level and to improve the security of your eduID, in addition to knowledge of your username (e.g. confirmed email address) and password combination, you can use another layer of authentication to log in. This is called multi-Factor authentication (MFA); and in eduID's case usually two-factor authentication (2FA).

securityLevel.description1.string: Though the terms are sometimes used interchangeably, an example of a {securityKey} would be a physical device in your possession, such as a specific type of USB hardware token for this purpose, that requires you to be present by the device, providing a high level of security.

securityLevel.description2.string: You can also add a {passkey} on your device that you can use to log in. The passkey may be used with biometric information such as fingerprint, face-recognition or a PIN depending on your device. The biometric information or PIN is never shared with us, only the passkey itself. Passkeys are often synced between your devices, providing ease of use.

securityLevel.description3.string: These techniques are a form of cryptography, where a public/private key pair is bound to your specific account on a particular website, in this case eduID.se. The private key is stored in an "authenticator" module, either built into your hardware key, your device or a credential manager app. It is considered phishing-resistant and removes the need for remembered passwords.

usingEduID.create.string: How to register your new eduID account at {eduidRegisterLink}:

usingEduID.create1.string: Enter your first name, last name and email address in the form and press the ”Create eduID” button.

usingEduID.create2.string: Confirm that you are human using CAPTCHA by entering the displayed/read out code and press the ”Continue” button.

usingEduID.create3.string: Read and approve the eduID terms of use by pressing the ”I Accept” button.

usingEduID.create4.string: Verify your email address by entering the code emailed to you in the website form and press the ”Ok” button.

usingEduID.create5.string: Choose using the radio buttons between a suggested (automatically generated) password or one you create.

usingEduID.create6.string: When validated for strength, repeat the password in the corresponding field and press the ”Save” button.

usingEduID.create7.string: Take careful note of your login details (used email address and password)!

usingEduID.create8.string: You can now log in with your eduID.

usingEduID.error2.string: It could also be due to it being registered {implementation} of this feature, so will need to be readded in the Security section of eduID.se after logging in using another method, to get the full advantage of using your passkey.

usingEduID.login2.string: Added security alternatives are listed in the "Other options" dropdown below the security key button, such as BankID, Freja+, eIDAS or Freja eID, depending on what applies to your verified identity.

usingEduID.login3.string: Follow the instructions; e.g. scan your face, fingerprint or enter PIN code. (eduID does not retain this information as passkeys are stored locally on your own device or credential manager.)

usingEduID.loginEduid.string: If you have an eduID account, enter your credentials in the form at {eduidLoginLink} and press the button "Log in". Your username can be

usingEduID.loginEduid1.string: Focus the username field, or you may need to press the "Log in with passkey" button in the login form. (If first setting the "Remember me.." toggle below you could directly use your key at your next login.)

usingEduID.loginEduid2.string: your unique ID, shown on the logged in start page and under Account.

usingEduID.loginEduid3.developer_comment: login eduid - other devices list item 3
usingEduID.loginEduid3.string: On that second device, review the device requesting to be logged in and use the presented code to login by entering it within the time shown, in the first device.

usingEduID.loginEduidForgot.string: Note: depending on your previous settings you might need to re-verify your identity in eduID.

usingEduID.loginEduidForgot1.developer_comment: login eduid - forgot pw list item 1
usingEduID.loginEduidForgot1.string: Press the "Forgot your password?" link below the login form.

usingEduID.loginEduidForgot2.developer_comment: login eduid - forgot pw list item 2
usingEduID.loginEduidForgot2.string: Press the "Send email" button to receive a code to the email address presented on the page.

usingEduID.loginEduidForgot3.developer_comment: login eduid - forgot pw list item 3
usingEduID.loginEduidForgot3.string: Follow the instructions in the email within 2 hours. The steps to verify your email address and selecting a new password are the same as when you created your eduID.

usingEduID.loginEduidOther.developer_comment: login eduid - other device list definition
usingEduID.loginEduidOther.string: Use your credentials from another device than you wish to access eduID with:

usingEduID.loginEduidOther1.developer_comment: login eduid - other devices list item 1
usingEduID.loginEduidOther1.string: Press the "Other device" button in the login form.

usingEduID.loginEduidOther2.developer_comment: login eduid - other devices list item 2
usingEduID.loginEduidOther2.string: Scan the presented QR-code with the other device where you have your login credentials, e.g. security key or saved password.

usingEduID.loginEduidParagraph.string: Underneath the login form there is a toggle control called "Remember me on this device". If this is switched on the web browser will attempt to fill in your username and hidden password in the form. For a different account or on a shared device, set this to off.

usingEduID.loginEduidPasskey2.string: If any applicable passkeys exist, select the key you wish to use from the list presented.

usingEduID.loginEduidSecurity.developer_comment: login eduid - security key list definition
usingEduID.loginEduidSecurity.string: If you have added a security key for authentication under Security, it will be requested after the initial login form in an additional Security step:

usingEduID.loginEduidSecurity1.developer_comment: login eduid - security key list item 1
usingEduID.loginEduidSecurity1.string: Press the "Use my security key" button and follow the instructions, which will vary depending on your key.

usingEduID.loginEduidSecurity3.developer_comment: login eduid - security key list item 3
usingEduID.loginEduidSecurity3.string: If you don't wish to use a security key to log in unless required, set the "Always use a second factor (MFA) to log in to eduID" toggle control under Security to off.

usingEduID.loginEduidUsername1.string: any email address you have entered and confirmed in eduID under Account

usingEduID.loginParagraph.string: In some situations that require added security you will be asked to log in again (with your security key if you are using one), if more than 5 minutes have passed since you logged in, e.g:

usingEduID.loginParagraph2.string: When using a passkey credential, the access, presentation and required steps will vary depending on your device, browser and type of key:

usingEduID.note.string: Note: you can read more about passkeys and how to add them in the "Enhancing the security level of eduID" help section.

usingEduID.paragraph.string: Note: you can read more about security keys in the "Enhancing the security level of eduID" help section."

usingEduID.paragraph1.string: A passkey added to your eduID account can either be used to log in following username and password or by itself. For passwordless login using only your passkey, you need to have registered a supported passkey (sometimes called a "discoverable passkey") after October 2025, when eduID included support of this functionality, as they were not fully considered passkeys before.

usingEduID.paragraph2.string: These settings are also marked with a "i" icon, with additional information on hover.

verifyIdentity.bankid.string: the user will be asked to verify themself using their BankID service. If you don't have BankID you have to create it separately before you can complete verification of your eduID. Read more about BankID below.

verifyIdentity.bankidParagraph.string: BankID is a widely used electronic verification system, available to holders of a Swedish personal identification number, an approved Swedish ID document (e.g. passport, drivers license or ID card) and connected to a bank in Sweden.

verifyIdentity.eidasParagraph.string: eIDAS is a federation of EU countries providing electronic identification to allow access to public authority systems for EU citizens, using their country's electronic ID.

verifyIdentity.eidasPersonalParagraph.string: If you have a Swedish personal identity number, use that method instead e.g. to simplify communication with Swedish authorities. Note: if you initially verify your identity with eIDAS and later receive a Swedish personal identity number you can add it in eduID and verify yourself again using it in the Identity area.

verifyIdentity.error.string: Note: not all nationalities are yet supported by this solution but the work to substantially increase the range is in progress.

verifyIdentity.needParagraph.developer_comment: need visit atg agent for freja - paragraph
verifyIdentity.needParagraph.string: Only if you use another means of identification than a Swedish passport, {protectedId}. On site, the agent can start the verification process by scanning a QR code in your app and follow the instructions in their terminal. You will be informed when you have passed the ID verification and will be able use your Freja+ with your eduID. It can take up to three hours for your Freja+ to be fully activated.

verifyIdentity.paragraph.developer_comment: what if verification for freja fails - paragraph
verifyIdentity.paragraph.string: Reinstall the app, redo the registration and make sure that you have entered the correct expiration date as well as the correct reference number of the chosen form of ID and personal identity number or coordination number.

verifyIdentity.paragraph1.string: Freja is an eID based on an identity verification platform using biometric passports, combined with the users mobile device to create a verified digital identity than can be used remotely.

verifyIdentity.paragraph2.string: You can read more about using Freja with your eduID below in the "About Freja (with Swedish ID/COORD number)" section and on their website at {FrejaProtectedId}.

verifyIdentity.use.string: How to use Freja with eduID:

verifyIdentity.use1.string: install the {Freja} on your mobile device (iOS or Android) and create a Freja+ account according to the instructions,

verifyIdentity.use2.string: if you have a valid Swedish passport you can complete the verification of your account in the app using your device camera, or bring a valid ID (including drivers license or ID card) to the nearest ATG agent authorised to verify your identity,

verifyIdentity.use3.string: log in to eduID and choose the 'Freja+ digital ID' option in the Identity area and follow the instructions.

verifyIdentity.useBankid.string: How to use BankID with eduID:

verifyIdentity.useBankid1.string: the BankID is obtained from your personal bank and installed on your device as an app or file. The process varies, so visit your bank's website and follow the instructions. You can read more about obtaining a BankID on {bankid},

verifyIdentity.useBankid2.string: log in to eduID and choose the 'Electronic BankID' option in the Identity area and follow the instructions.

verifyIdentity.useEidas.string: How to use eIDAS with eduID:

verifyIdentity.useEidas1.string: make sure you have an electronic ID from a connected country to have the possibility to authenticate yourself via eIDAS,

verifyIdentity.useEidas2.string: to verify your identity in eduID, log in and choose the verification method for 'EU-citizens' in the Identity area and follow the instructions.

verifyIdentity.useFreja.string: How to use Freja+ with eduID:

verifyIdentity.useInternational1.string: to verify your eduID using Freja you first need to get a Freja account with a verified profile supported by your passport, by installing the {FrejaApp} on your mobile device (iOS or Android) and following the instructions,

verifyIdentity.useInternational2.string: login to eduID and scan the QR code produced by Freja from the 'Other countries' section in the Identity area of eduID by following the instructions.
